intro.text: You're smaller than I expected. That's not an insult. Most people I drive away from are bigger. And louder. And usually bleeding. You look like you can handle yourself, though.
intro.speaker: Yordano

driving_intro.text: I handle driving, extraction, and 'aggressive negotiation.' That's when someone doesn't want to move and I convince them. I'm very convincing. I have a crowbar.
driving_intro.speaker: Yordano

caught_story.text: Once. Highway patrol. I was doing 140 in a 65. The officer asked why I was in a hurry. I said my wife was in labor. He asked where my wife was. I pointed to the empty passenger seat and said 'she's very small.' He didn't believe me. I still got away. That's the important part.
caught_story.speaker: Yordano

escape_story.text: I told him I was a volunteer firefighter responding to a cat in a tree. Then I showed him a laminated badge I bought online. Then I offered to help him with his taxes. People will believe anything if you offer to do their taxes.
escape_story.speaker: Yordano

crowbar_talk.text: The crowbar is a tool of last resort. First resort is talking. Second resort is driving around the problem. Third resort is the crowbar. I've only needed it twice. Both times, the problem moved very quickly afterward.
crowbar_talk.speaker: Yordano

getaway_request.text: Always. It's what I do. You need fast, quiet, or loud? Fast is my specialty. Quiet requires a different car. Loud requires a different attitude. Which flavor of trouble are you planning?
getaway_request.speaker: Yordano

fast_plan.text: Fast I can do. I've got a '98 Civic with an engine that shouldn't exist. The previous owner was a NASA engineer with a felony record. It's basically a spaceship with cupholders.
fast_plan.speaker: Yordano

quiet_plan.text: Quiet means electric. I know a guy who knows a guy who imports Teslas with 'questionable paperwork.' They're silent. Eerily silent. You can hear your own heartbeat. It's unsettling.
quiet_plan.speaker: Yordano

loud_plan.text: Loud means a '71 Charger with a supercharger that screams like an angry god. Everyone hears you coming. Everyone gets out of the way. It's not subtle. Subtle is for people who don't enjoy their work.
loud_plan.speaker: Yordano

car_talk.text: Right now? A 2015 Camry. Boring, reliable, invisible. The perfect getaway car is the one no one remembers. But for special occasions? I have a '69 Mustang in a garage across town. It's red. It's loud. It's beautiful. I only drive it when I need to feel alive.
car_talk.speaker: Yordano

mustang_invite.text: Sure. But you have to promise not to touch the radio. It's set to classic rock and that's the way it stays. Jake tried to change it to jazz once. I didn't speak to him for a week.
mustang_invite.speaker: Yordano

camry_smart.text: The Camry is smart. The Camry is safe. The Camry has saved my life four times because no one looks twice at a beige sedan. Sometimes the most dangerous thing you can be is interesting.
camry_smart.speaker: Yordano

goodbye.text: Drive safe. Or drive fast. Your call.
goodbye.speaker: Yordano
